name: typecho-plugin-queue
description: Provide asynchronous task transport and queue monitoring through Cloudflare Queues.

plugin.name: Queue
plugin.description: Background task transport and queue monitoring for Cloudflare Workers. Disabling stops new tasks; pending messages retry and are discarded at the retry limit.
plugin.author: eslizn

queueName.label: Queue name
queueName.description: Shown on the admin Queue page and used for drift warnings. Keep it aligned with the Wrangler producer/consumer queue name.

accountId.label: Cloudflare account ID
accountId.description: Optional. Enables account-level queue configuration and metrics.

apiToken.label: Cloudflare API token
apiToken.description: Optional. Use a token with only the Queues Read permission. Stored in the site database.
